name: codeninja
description: CodeNinja — a full-stack learning platform for the 30-day Full-Stack Developer track

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @codeninja/api" "npm run dev -w @codeninja/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @codeninja/content && npm run build -w @codeninja/api && npm run build -w @codeninja/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run generate -w @codeninja/api && npm run migrate -w @codeninja/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @codeninja/content && npm run seed -w @codeninja/api
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
